correctness.rationale: Explicit seven-point path and cycle families satisfy the graph-CFF definition. Exhaustive symmetry-reduced enumeration excludes six-point P_11 and C_10 families and seven-point W_11 families; positive controls recover previously known feasible boundary cases. Monotonicity and the published universal-vertex result complete the stated exact values.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The directly relevant 2026 source leaves these small entries as upper bounds and asks for improved path/cycle constructions. Targeted searches did not locate the exact closures or the seven-point n=13,14,15 constructions. Differently named structured group-testing and hypergraph-CFF literature remains a residual coverage risk.

value.rationale: The result completes the source paper's unresolved small path/cycle/wheel table through n=12 and extends exact path and cycle values through n=15, improving the previous general upper bound from 8 to 7 at n=13,14,15.
